title: More walks to be read aloud
items: Next in line to be read aloud, after the battle and the 1904 story walks: Famous names of Prairie Avenue, Women of Prairie Avenue, Ghosts of Prairie Avenue, Architects of Prairie Avenue, and the Italianate, Romanesque and Second Empire style walks.
Also queued: Fort Dearborn, Building by Building, Chicago's First Murder, and the younger and older tellings of the Battle of Fort Dearborn, all in the Cultivated Essayist's smooth reading.
